name: S600P-4G-1G_24V EN.doc
method: soffice→docx→python-docx(段落+表格+文本框+页眉页脚)
text:
Model	S600P-4G-1G-24V
Product mame	4 Port Full Gigabit PoE Switch
Fixed Port	4*10/100/1000Base-TX PoE port（Data/Power） / 1*10/100/1000Base-TX uplink RJ45 port (Data)
PoE Ports	1-4 port supports IEEE802.3, max 30W/port, PoE out  24V
PoE Pin	af/at: 45+ 78-
PoE Bridge	max 65W
Bandwidth	10Gbps
Packet Forwarding	7.44Mpps
MAC	2K
Buffer	2.5M
Transmission Distance	10BASE-T ： Cat3,4,5 UTP(≤250 meter) / 100BASE-TX ： Cat5 or later UTP(150 meter) / 1000BASE-TX ： Cat6 or later UTP(150 meter)
LED Indicator	P:Power LED(over-power LED) / Uplink:(Link LED=10/100M Link、1000M=Gigabit Link） / Port:(Orange=PoE LED, Green=LAN Link LED）
Power	Built-in power AC：100-240Vac 50-60Hz   max 65W
Operating Temperature/Humidity	-10～+55°C；5%～90% RH Non coagulation
Storage Temperature/Humidity	-40～+75°C；5%～95% RH Non coagulation
Product /Packing / size（L*W*H）	190mm*130mm*35mm / 265mm*220mm*68mm
N.W/G.W（kg）	0.6kg/1.0kg
Lightning / Protection  level	6KV 8/20us； / IP30
Installation	Desktop (optional wall +machine hangers)
Certificate	CE-EMC EN55032；CE-LVD EN62368；
FCC Part 15 Class B；RoHS；
Warranty	Whole device for 1 year(Accessories not included)
